description: This file defines the AWS SecretsManagerClient class, which serves as a client interface for interacting with the AWS Secrets Manager service. It contains method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, and describing secrets, as well as managing resource policies and secret versions.

classes.name: SecretsManagerClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Secrets Manager service, providing methods for secret management and other related operations.

methods.name: batchGetSecretValue
methods.description: Retrieves multiple secret values in a single request.

methods.name: cancelRotateSecret
methods.description: Cancels the rotation of a secret.

methods.name: createSecret
methods.description: Creates a new secret.

methods.name: deleteResourcePolicy
methods.description: Deletes the resource policy associated with a secret.

methods.name: deleteSecret
methods.description: Deletes a secret.

methods.name: describeSecret
methods.description: Retrieves information about a secret.

methods.name: getRandomPassword
methods.description: Generates a random password based on specified parameters.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the resource policy attached to a secret.

methods.name: getSecretValue
methods.description: Retrieves the decrypted secret value.

methods.name: listSecretVersionIds
methods.description: Lists version IDs of a secret.

methods.name: listSecrets
methods.description: Lists all secrets.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Attaches a resource policy to a secret.

methods.name: putSecretValue
methods.description: Stores a new version of the secret value.

methods.name: removeRegionsFromReplication
methods.description: Removes regions from the replication set.

methods.name: replicateSecretToRegions
methods.description: Replicates a secret to specified regions.

methods.name: restoreSecret
methods.description: Restores a secret from a previous version.

methods.name: rotateSecret
methods.description: Configures and initiates the rotation of a secret.

methods.name: stopReplicationToReplica
methods.description: Stops replication of a secret to a replica region.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a secret.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a secret.

methods.name: updateSecret
methods.description: Updates the details of a secret.

methods.name: updateSecretVersionStage
methods.description: Modifies the staging labels of a secret version.

methods.name: validateResourcePolicy
methods.description: Validates the resource policy.
